value.code: \log p_{\theta}\!\left(x^{(i)}\right) = D_{\mathrm{KL}}\!\left(q_{\phi}(z \mid x^{(i)}) \,\|\, p_{\theta}(z \mid x^{(i)})\right) + \mathcal{L}\!\left(\theta,\phi; x^{(i)}\right).

\boxed{ \log p_{\theta}\!\left(x^{(i)}\right) \ge \mathcal{L}\!\left(\theta,\phi; x^{(i)}\right) = \mathbb{E}_{q_{\phi}(z \mid x^{(i)})} \!\left[ -\log q_{\phi}(z \mid x^{(i)}) + \log p_{\theta}(x^{(i)}, z) \right] }

\boxed{ \mathcal{L}\!\left(\theta,\phi; x^{(i)}\right) = - \underbrace{D_{\mathrm{KL}}\!\left(q_{\phi}(z \mid x^{(i)}) \,\|\, p_{\theta}(z)\right)}_{\text{Regularization (KL Divergence)}} + \underbrace{\mathbb{E}_{q_{\phi}(z \mid x^{(i)})} \!\left[ \log p_{\theta}(x^{(i)} \mid z) \right]}_{\text{Reconstruction Likelihood}} }

\boxed{ \mathcal{L}^{B}(\theta,\phi; x^{(i)}) = - D_{\mathrm{KL}}\!\left(q_{\phi}(z\mid x^{(i)}) \,\|\, p_{\theta}(z)\right) + \frac{1}{L}\sum_{l=1}^{L} \log p_{\theta}\!\left(x^{(i)} \mid z^{(i,l)}\right) }
z^{(i,l)} = g_{\phi}(\epsilon^{(l)}, x^{(i)}), \quad z^{(i,l)} \sim q_{\phi}(z\mid x^{(i)}).
\int q_{\phi}(z\mid x)\, f(z)\, dz = \int p(\epsilon)\, f(z)\, d\epsilon = \int p(\epsilon)\, f\!\bigl(g_{\phi}(\epsilon, x)\bigr)\, d\epsilon.

\boxed{ \hat{p}_\theta(x^{(0)}) = \frac{1}{K} \sum_{k=1}^K \underbrace{ \frac{p_\theta(x_k^{(T)}) \prod_{t=1}^T p_\theta(x_k^{(t-1)} \mid x_k^{(t)})}{\prod_{t=1}^T q(x_k^{(t)} \mid x_k^{(t-1)})} }_{\text{Importance Weight } w_k} }

L = \int dx^{(0)}\, q\bigl(x^{(0)}\bigr)\cdot \log \left[ \int dx^{(1\cdots T)} \, q\bigl(x^{(1\cdots T)}\mid x^{(0)}\bigr)\cdot \frac{ p\bigl(x^{(T)}\bigr)\prod_{t=1}^{T} p\bigl(x^{(t-1)}\mid x^{(t)}\bigr) }{ q\bigl(x^{(t)}\mid x^{(t-1)}\bigr) } \right]

L \ge \int dx^{(0\cdots T)}\, q\bigl(x^{(0\cdots T)}\bigr)\cdot \log \left[ p\bigl(x^{(T)}\bigr) \prod_{t=1}^{T} \frac{ p\bigl(x^{(t-1)}\mid x^{(t)}\bigr) }{ q\bigl(x^{(t)}\mid x^{(t-1)}\bigr) } \right]
q\bigl(x^{(t+1)}\mid x^{(t)}\bigr)\, q\bigl(x^{(t)}\bigr) = q\bigl(x^{(t)}\mid x^{(t+1)}\bigr)\, q\bigl(x^{(t+1)}\bigr)
\tilde q\bigl(x^{(t+1)}\mid x^{(t)}\bigr)\, \tilde q\bigl(x^{(t)}\bigr) = \tilde q\bigl(x^{(t)}\mid x^{(t+1)}\bigr)\, \tilde q\bigl(x^{(t+1)}\bigr).

\boxed{ L \ge K = \int d\mathbf{x}^{(0\cdots T)} q\left(\mathbf{x}^{(0\cdots T)}\right) \log \left[ p\left(\mathbf{x}^{(T)}\right) \prod_{t=1}^T \frac{p\left(\mathbf{x}^{(t-1)} \mid \mathbf{x}^{(t)}\right)}{q\left(\mathbf{x}^{(t)} \mid \mathbf{x}^{(t-1)}\right)} \right] }

K= \int dx^{(0\cdots T)}\,q\bigl(x^{(0\cdots T)}\bigr) \sum_{t=1}^{T} \log\!\left[ \frac{p\bigl(x^{(t-1)}\mid x^{(t)}\bigr)} {q\bigl(x^{(t)}\mid x^{(t-1)}\bigr)} \right] + \int dx^{(T)}\,q\bigl(x^{(T)}\bigr)\log p\bigl(x^{(T)}\bigr).
K= \sum_{t=1}^{T} \int dx^{(0\cdots T)}\,q\bigl(x^{(0\cdots T)}\bigr) \log\!\left[ \frac{p\bigl(x^{(t-1)}\mid x^{(t)}\bigr)} {q\bigl(x^{(t)}\mid x^{(t-1)}\bigr)} \right] - H_p\bigl(X^{(T)}\bigr).
p\bigl(x^{(0)}\mid x^{(1)}\bigr) = q\bigl(x^{(1)}\mid x^{(0)}\bigr) \frac{\pi\bigl(x^{(0)}\bigr)}{\pi\bigl(x^{(1)}\bigr)} = T_\pi\bigl(x^{(0)}\mid x^{(1)};\beta_1\bigr).

K = \sum_{t=2}^{T} \int d\mathbf{x}^{(0\cdots T)} q\left(\mathbf{x}^{(0\cdots T)}\right) \log \left[ \frac{p\left(\mathbf{x}^{(t-1)}|\mathbf{x}^{(t)}\right)}{q\left(\mathbf{x}^{(t)}|\mathbf{x}^{(t-1)}, \mathbf{x}^{(0)}\right)} \right] - H_p\left(\mathbf{X}^{(T)}\right).

K = \sum_{t=2}^{T} \int d\mathbf{x}^{(0\cdots T)} q\left(\mathbf{x}^{(0\cdots T)}\right) \log \left[ \frac{p\left(\mathbf{x}^{(t-1)}|\mathbf{x}^{(t)}\right)}{q\left(\mathbf{x}^{(t-1)}|\mathbf{x}^{(t)}, \mathbf{x}^{(0)}\right)} \frac{q\left(\mathbf{x}^{(t-1)}|\mathbf{x}^{(0)}\right)}{q\left(\mathbf{x}^{(t)}|\mathbf{x}^{(0)}\right)} \right] - H_p\left(\mathbf{X}^{(T)}\right).
